note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after 51799ad534 (owner ruling 5c) and the annotation correction that follows it. RFC 4301 Section 5.2: "(No SAs are created in response to receipt of a packet that requires IPsec protection; only BYPASS or DISCARD cache entries can be created this way.) If there is no match, discard the traffic." Same producers and paths as RFC4301-5.2-1: a reload still refuses a catch-all it cannot install, but the daemon's start installs what the dataplane accepts and reports the rest (assertUnmatched, installUnmatchedAtStart, recordInterfaceCatchAllAtStart), so after such a start an inbound packet no entry matches is delivered in the refused direction until a restart or a vpn ipsec commit installs the entry. VPP still holds no catch-all, and the OSPF manual-key entries still have no final DISCARD outside the engine's window. The corrected annotation states the three paths accurately and cites tests that exist at HEAD. The gap stands.
